text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH p99 latency detected on /v1/chat/completions (prod). 30% requests > 2.5s over 5m. Contact: @alice.

alice: I'm on pager. seeing increased p99 across a few models (gpt-open-1, conv-lite). Investigating whether it's infra or model slowdown.

bharat: I see a spike in queue lengths on the routing tier and a small surge of long-running responses from a single host pool. No obvious OOMs.

maria: can we temporarily route traffic off the affected pool to dedicated nodes? we have spare capacity in eu-west-1-dedicated-2.

alice: good call. re-routed ~20% of traffic for chat-completions -> dedicated pool. p99 dropped from ~3.1s -> 2.1s for the overall endpoint, but still noisy.

kevin: adding that the completions endpoint (/v1/completions) isn't impacted. this looks specific to chat path (prefix routing + heavier decoding).

alice: paging note: customer-facing impact appears limited to high-latency tails, not errors. flagged CS to monitor for support tickets.

oncall-rotation: handoff in 20m to @bharat. leaving notes: routing surge, temporary route split, scaling triggered but kernel queues persisted.

alice: immediate mitigation done. now we need to reduce alert noise and tune thresholds. Current monitor: Datadog monitor `redwood.chat.p99` fires on p99 > 2.0s for last 5m. That was helpful but too noisy per-model.

maria: proposal: switch to per-route/per-model monitors and move base p99 threshold to 2.5s for heavy models (gpt-open-1, conv-lite), keep 1.5s for lightweight models. Also add a p95 monitor for regressions  (p95 > 1.0s) to catch bulk shifts.

bharat: agree. also add an alert suppression window for post-deploy noise: when a deployment tag `deploy:chat` is present, mute p99 alerts for 10m and route them to an auto-ticket instead.

kevin: suggested Datadog query examples: 
```
# p99 for route /v1/chat/completions, per-model
avg(last_5m):pctl(99, sum:trace.request.duration{route:chat-completions,model:gpt-open-1}.as_count()) > 2.5
```
and for p95 regression watch:
```
avg(last_5m):pctl(95, sum:trace.request.duration{route:chat-completions}.as_count()) > 1.0
```

alice: good. we should commit these as separate monitors: `chat-completions.p99.{model}`, `chat-completions.p95.global`, `completions.p99.global` so we can silence specific models.

maria: I drafted an `alerting.yml` snippet to add to infra-config: 
```
- name: "chat-completions.p99.gpt-open-1"
  type: datadog_monitor
  query: "avg(last_5m):pctl(99, sum:trace.request.duration{route:chat-completions,model:gpt-open-1}.as_count()) > 2.5"
  notify: ["#eng-oncall","pagerduty:chat-oncall"]
  suppress_when: "deploy.tag:chat"
  suppress_duration: 600
- name: "chat-completions.p95.global"
  type: datadog_monitor
  query: "avg(last_5m):pctl(95, sum:trace.request.duration{route:chat-completions}.as_count()) > 1.0"
  notify: ["#eng-telemetry"]
```

bharat: a few more operational asks:
- Create a dashboard tile comparing p50/p95/p99 across models for chat vs completions.
- Add a per-route heatmap for queue length on the routing tier.
- Add an annotation layer for recent rollouts to correlate deploys.

kevin: I'll make the dashboard. name: `infra/chat-latency-by-model`. Panels: timeseries p50/p95/p99, distribution histogram, routing queue length.

alice: who will implement the monitor changes? I can do the `alerting.yml` PR if someone reviews quickly.

maria: I'll review. also add a runbook link in the monitors to `RUNBOOKS/chat-latency.md` so oncall has mitigation steps (route split, scale pool, fallback model).

oncall-rotation: handoff to @bharat now. summary: mitigations applied, monitoring tuned proposal accepted, follow-ups assigned (dashboard, PR, runbook link).

bharat: taking handoff. I'll keep the temporary route split for 2 more hours and then revert if stable. filing follow-up tickets:
- TICKET-2143: Per-model p99 monitors + suppression on deploys (assigned to alice)
- TICKET-2144: Dashboard `infra/chat-latency-by-model` (assigned to kevin)
- TICKET-2145: Update runbook and add deployment annotation (assigned to maria)

alice: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-config/pulls/412 (alerting.yml changes). request review from @maria @kevin.

maria: reviewed and left comments re: tags and notify channels. small nit: use `notify: ["#eng-oncall", "#eng-telemetry"]` not pagerduty for p95. save pagerduty for p99 only.

bharat: post-incident checklist:
- Complete PR and deploy new monitors (alice)
- Dashboard up in staging then prod (kevin)
- Runbook updated (maria)
- Re-evaluate thresholds after 24h of new monitors and post metrics summary in #incidents (bharat)

sre-bot: Incident closed (status: mitigated). Duration: 00:48:36. Follow-ups: TICKET-2143,TICKET-2144,TICKET-2145.

alice: thanks all — good teamwork. I'll update the incident summary for CS and postmortem notes later tonight.

maria: capturing notes in #incidents for visibility.

kevin: starting dashboard work now, will ping when the staging link is available.

bharat: leaving the route split on, will hand back to next rotation at 1750007510 if stable.

alice: handing off final to @oncall-rotation at end of shift.
